tools.name: search_inventory
tools.description:
Search the SYNTHETIC demo inventory (about 860 fictional vehicles at 20 fictional dealers in TX, CA, FL, GA, AZ,
IL, NY and OH). Results are not real vehicles for sale; say so when you show them.
Each result has listing_id (dealer_key:VIN), vehicle basics, headline_price (before tax, title and fees)

type, range or allowed values, shortcut names, the operators (eq, any_of, contains, range, bool, exists, negate) and
example filters for search_inventory. The full compact list is about

tools.name: get_payment_estimate
tools.description:
Use this to answer 'what would my monthly payment be' for ONE listing. It runs the same itemized
out-the-door calculation as estimate_out_the_door (always treated as financed) and turns it into a DEMO monthly
finance payment: out-the-door total minus down payment and trade equity, amortized at the A

tools.name: compare_payment_scenarios
tools.description:
Use this to compare several financing what-ifs for ONE listing side by side in one call (for example cash
down, term, credit tier or APR, trade-in, incentives). Each scenario reruns the itemized out-the-door estimate and
returns estimated_out_the_door, amount_financed_estimate, apr_percent and apr_s

to the MCP URL. Nothing else changes: anonymous use keeps working, limits are th

tools.description:
DEMO. Save a car search and get alerted when new cars match. Returns a search_id (keep it; it is the only way to
read or cancel the search) and an expiry (default 30 days, renewable). Check for new cars with get_new_matches, or
give a callback_url. Shopper email alerts are optional and need explicit

tools.name: get_new_matches
tools.description: DEMO. New cars that started matching a saved search after it was saved (or after `since`).

tools.name: cancel_search
tools.description: DEMO. Cancel a saved search. Any shopper email stored for it is deleted.

tools.name: prepare_dealer_handoff
tools.description:
Use this when the shopper has picked a car and a deal structure and wants to take it to the dealer. Builds a
structured dealer handoff package for ONE configured deal: vehicle and VIN, the full itemized out-the-door
estimate (with excluded items such as optional add-ons), the chosen financing scenar

tools.name: get_listing
tools.description:
Full synthetic listing record with per-value provenance (method 'synthetic'). listing_id is dealer_key:VIN (as
returned by search_inventory) or the urn. The vehicle-to-store link is in listing.selling_location (link_status,
selling_location_id, candidates, flags such as group_site_lists_sister_store

tools.name: get_price_breakdown
tools.description:
Use this to see what the dealer LISTS for ONE listing, as published: headline price, MSRP (new cars),
price_components, dealer fees (doc fee and others) and fee bundles (parts marked part_of_bundle, not double
counted), flags such as whether the advertised price already includes fees, options, incen

tools.name: estimate_out_the_door
tools.description:
Use this for the buyer's TOTAL price of ONE listing: an itemized out-the-door DEMO ESTIMATE for the buyer's
state, county and city, built with real public tax and fee rules for the 8 covered states. Lines include the
price, dealer fees, eligible incentives, state and local sales tax, title and regis

tools.name: get_dealer
tools.description:
Fictional dealer profile: registry entity, stores (selling locations) with fictional addresses and 555 phone
numbers, group, state rules and a page of inventory. Not a real business; do not tell anyone to call or visit.

tools.name: list_dealers
tools.description:
All 20 fictional demo dealers with group and store counts (each dealer lists its stores with group_id, region_id
and store_id), the dealer hierarchy (Group, then Region, then Store), the 4 fictional dealer groups and a coverage
summary: which metros have demo stores, with dealer, store and new/used

tools.name: get_media
tools.description:
Media block for a listing: self-generated SVG placeholder images labeled DEMO (photo, video poster, spin), with
rights notes. They are not photos of a real car. No video or 360 viewer exists in the demo.

tools.name: get_trade_in_scenarios
tools.description:
Ready-made demo trade-in scenarios (one per state) with trade_value and payoff to pass to estimate_out_the_door
or get_payment_estimate.

tools.name: get_ontology
tools.description:
Schema links, schema version, covered states, condition values, search sorts and the value-wrapper format
({v, m, c, src}). For the list of filterable fields and allowed values, use list_searchable_fields.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_search, cancel_search · Private data: prepare_dealer_handoff, get_listing · Public sink: register_agent, save_search, cancel_search, prepare_dealer_handoff · Destructive: search_inventory, get_ontology.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_search, cancel_search · Private data: prepare_dealer_handoff, get_listing · Public sink: register_agent, save_search, cancel_search, prepare_dealer_handoff · Destructive: search_inventory, get_ontology

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
